text: Dozens of visual icons in that pane, and it's tempting to pick whichever looks most impressive. Here's the better approach.

Start from the question, not the icon. Comparing categories — bar or column. Showing change over time — line. Parts of a whole — pie, donut, or treemap. Exact values — table or matrix. One number that matters most — a card.

Four questions settle almost every choice: what are you asking, how many categories are involved, does the audience need exact numbers or just a visual impression, and will this visual need to filter or be filtered by others on the page.
Next: tables and matrices — the visual for when exact values matter most.
